description: This file defines a Java interface named 'Field' representing a mathematical field, with methods to access additive and multiplicative identities and the runtime class of field elements.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Interface representing a mathematical field with methods to retrieve zero, one, and runtime class of elements.

methods.name: getZero
methods.description: Returns the additive identity element of the field.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Returns the multiplicative identity element of the field.

methods.name: getRuntimeClass
methods.description: Returns the runtime class of the field elements.
